name: PGS000004 (PRS313_BC, breast cancer)
provenance: real 1000 Genomes phase-3 genotypes + published PGS000004 (PRS313) weights (PGS Catalog: per-score licence, EMBL-EBI terms by default; IGSR grants no blanket licence). 30 of 2,504 individuals ship in the browser payload - DATA_LICENSES section 4 justifies a slice of that size, not the full matrix. Variants keyed by chr:pos:effect_allele because PGS000004 publishes no rsIDs.
